question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**pursuit**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage describes Drummle following her and being behind her, indicating he was in the process of pursuing her.
 
• The noun should appropriately describe the act of following or chasing.
 
• "**Pursuit**" fits well as it commonly refers to the act of following or chasing someone or something.
 
• Other options ("**quest**", "**seeking**", "**perusal**") do not accurately convey the sense of actively chasing or following someone in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.
